name: MGS Recommend to a Friend
author: MD MONIRUZZAMAN

sections.description:
MGS Recommend to a Friend is a WordPress Plugin for recommending any link/URL to a friends.

This plugin has been built to recommend friends about any Website URL.

This plugin generates a Full Responsive Ajax Recommendation Form. Get the IP of the sender inside the email body.

The MGS Recommend to a Friend plugin can be simply integrated into your website with plugin settings and a shortcode. It looks great with all types of devices. Try out the demo.

LIVE DEMO 🚀

FEATURES

  • Extremely easy Configuration
  • Display a Floating Button to open a Modal Recommendation Form using Shortcode
  • Font Awesome 7 Icons
  • Ajax Request Form Process
  • Friend will receive an email with sender information and the recommend url (recommended web page URL)
  • Get the IP of the sender inside the email body
  • GDPR ready (Consent checkbox Field settings included)
  • 100% Responsive and Mobile-Friendly Layout
  • Dedicated Support
  • and Much More!

Configuration Settings Included
* Options for email Template
* Options for Recommendation Form Fields
* Options for Consent (Name, Text, URL) checkbox
sections.installation:
1. Install MGS Recommend to a Friend plugin either via the WordPress.org plugin repository or by uploading the files to your server.
  2. Activate MGS Recommend to a Friend plugin.
  3. Navigate to the Settings page of MGS Recommend to a Friend plugin and configure the settings according to your needs.
sections.faq:

Feel free to create a topic.
